siladi.title: Personalised gifts from Križevci
siladi.description: For baptisms, First Communions, weddings and other occasions I make gifts to order, with the name, date or message of your choice: gift sets, wooden money boxes, LED lamps, frames and cake toppers. Each piece is laser engraved, laser cut or 3D printed. I ship anywhere in Croatia, or you can pick your order up in Križevci.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: What the Local Heritage Project form collects, why, and how we look after it.
privacy.intro: This notice covers the form you use to send words, expressions and memories to the Local Heritage Project. It explains what we collect, why we need it and what we do with it.

controller.title: Who looks after your data
text: The data controller is Karlo Siladi, who runs this site and the project. For any privacy question, email {email}.

collected.title: What we collect
text: When you send the form, we store:
items: the word, expression or memory you wrote
the type of submission and the place where it is used, if you fill them in
your name, if you give it
a way to contact you, such as an email address or phone number, if you give one
your consent to publication, the language of the page and the time you sent it
after: We do not store your IP address with your submission. The server keeps it in memory briefly, only to prevent abuse such as too many submissions in a short time. Our hosting provider may keep standard technical logs of visits to the site.

purpose.title: Why
text: We use submissions to preserve and share local heritage: the words, expressions, memories and traditions of Sveti Petar Orehovec, Križevci and the wider region. They may appear on this site and in heritage content and games, such as word cards, quizzes, a word map and stories.
We only use your contact details if we need to ask you a follow-up question about your submission.
We process your data on the basis of your consent, which you give by ticking the box on the form.

optional.title: Your name and contact are optional
text: You can send a submission without a name or contact details. If you give your name, we may credit you with it when we publish your submission; leave it empty if you’d rather not be named. We never publish contact details.

review.title: Review and publication
text: We review every submission first. We only publish what we have reviewed and approved, and only with the consent you give on the form. We may edit a submission lightly, for example to fix a typo or shorten it, without changing its meaning.
Submissions we don’t publish are not shown to anyone.

retention.title: How long we keep your data
items: We go through submissions by hand and, from time to time, delete the ones we don’t publish, including rejected ones. Nothing is deleted automatically, so there is no fixed deadline.
Published submissions stay for as long as the project runs, or until you ask us to remove them.
We keep contact details only while we may need them for follow-up questions, and then delete them by hand. If you ask, we delete your name or contact details sooner.

access.title: Who can see your data
text: Only Karlo Siladi can see unpublished submissions, names and contact details. The data is stored in a database provided for this site by Supabase, which processes it only on our behalf, as our processor. [TO CHECK: add the region of the Supabase project here before publishing.] We do not sell it or share it with anyone else.

rights.title: Correction, deletion and your other rights
text: At any time you can ask to see the data we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, or to withdraw your consent to publication. Just email {email} and tell us which submission it is about, for example by quoting its text and roughly when you sent it. We will reply within one month.
If you withdraw your consent, we will remove your submission from the site and the games. This does not change anything published before then.
If you think we are not handling your data properly, you can also contact the Croatian data protection authority, the Personal Data Protection Agency (azop.hr).

changes.title: Changes to this notice
text: If we change this notice, we will publish the new version on this page with a new date.

challenge.title: Heritage challenge
challenge.intro: Play at your own pace, learn something new and invite your friends to try to match your score.
challenge.sampleNotice: This is sample content, not a verified quiz about Križevci or Sveti Petar Orehovec. Words are unverified samples; the other examples are fictional. Real local content is still to come.
challenge.rules: No timer. Correct answers earn 100 points; incorrect or skipped answers earn 0. One attempt per participant in this challenge. Equal scores share a rank.
challenge.resumeNotice: Progress is saved on the server. Continue in this browser: a nickname cannot recover an attempt on another device. Clearing browser data loses access to your attempt.
challenge.interruption: Take a break whenever you need. A revealed question stays current until you answer or skip it. You cannot go back or restart a round.
challenge.expiry: A challenge lasts 7 days. Each newly completed attempt leaves at least 3 more days, up to 30 days from creation. Visits and incomplete attempts do not extend it.
challenge.nicknameHelp: 2–24 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces and . _ apostrophe or hyphen. Your nickname, progress and scores will be public.
